mission.title: Strange Bedfellows
mission.description: Trade a flit gun prototype to Zion for the insecticide.

npc.say: I will be interested to see your progress with the followers of Zion. I have always found them... difficult to deal with.
I'm glad to see we can work this out together, {player}. We don't want to lose any more operatives, and I'm sure you don't, either.
As long as you're gunning for the Assassin, we're okay... after that, all bets are off.

phase.briefing:
Our current situation is a somewhat... unusual one for us, {player}. We have assembled the components into what you might call a "flit gun" of sorts. I am certain you grasp the nature of the pest for which this flit gun is designed.
However, we must have pesticide for the guns to be effective. The only pesticide effective against the Assassin is in the possession of Zion.
You have been selected to carry out a trade with Zion operatives. I trust that you will be able to deal effectively with your fellow humans.

enter.say: You'll need to pick up one of the flit gun prototypes here first, as part of the trade. Keep an eye out for your contact, Agent Marks.

talk.say: {player}. I suppose you are here for the flit gun. You may take it from me.

objective.text: Get the flit gun from Agent Marks

talk.say: I do not understand your confusion, {player}. I have the flit gun device for you.

done.say: That's the prototype. Kinda weird-looking if you ask me... Anyhow, time to get out of here and head over to the rendezvous.

phase.briefing:
Proceed to the appointed meeting place and trade with the human known as Ponch.
In light of the current truce, please do not allow any Zion-affiliated humans to die during your interactions with them.

enter.say: All right, Ponch and her team should be somewhere in this area.
Looks like we've got company! Take out those intruders.

talk.say:
Well, I didn't think you'd really show, {player}. When we heard we'd be meeting up with Machinists... let's just say we were a little dubious.
And to be honest, we still are. I don't trust you, {player}. I don't trust anyone working for... what th--
Damn... can't argue with fighting like that. Whatd'ya think, Ponch?
What?! You gotta be kidding me! We're talking about the Machines here, not some--

done.say: Sounds like we'll have to head to the Zion base if we're going to make this trade.

No, he's right, Broomfondle. Anybody puts their life on the line for us, I can't ignore that.
Listen, I don't have the insecticide. We didn't trust this whole deal from the start. But now...
Let's head back to Forward Ops. Someone there'll know what to do.

objective.text: Do not let Ponch, Angstrom or Broomfondle die

phase.briefing:
Such a level of distrust does not surprise me, {player}. Our studies have shown humans to be inherently untrustworthy; due to their bizarre psychology, they project this distrust onto others.
Regardless, we are pleased that you seem to have earned their trust for the moment. I assured my colleagues that you would be the appropriate asset for this assignment, and it is obvious that I was correct.
Proceed to the location indicated and perform the trade.

enter.say: Zion Forward Ops... it really is something that Ponch brought you here. Keep an eye out for Dobronravin; it looks like she'll be making the trade with you.

talk.say:
{player}. I'm glad you came here... there's something I need to talk to you about.
One of our operatives came across something on one of his missions against the Merovingian. It seems to be encrypted with a code we can't break and... well, we need your help decoding it.
We need to overcome our differences right now. Most of the people in Zion wouldn't approve of this meeting... but I think we share a common goal: the end of the Assassin. Can we work together on this?
The actions this human has outlined appear quite logical to us. Cooperation between the Machines and Zion would be beneficial. Obtain the disk from him and we shall analyze it in due course.

done.say: I'm glad to see we can work this out together, {player}. We don't want to lose any more operatives, and I'm sure you don't, either.

objective.text: Give the flit gun to Dobronravin

talk.say: Okay, looks good... you can take the pesticide.

done.say: All right, that's everything. We should get this stuff over to the Machine lab. I'm curious to see what's on that disk...

phase.briefing: I have updated your display with the location of our nearest research facility. Proceed there with the insecticide and the disk.

enter.say: Be on the lookout for Agent Miller in here. You'll be giving the insecticide to him.

objective.text: Give the insecticide to Agent Miller

talk.say: I understand you have the insecticide, {player}. Give it to me.

done.say: The computer in this room is equipped with a powerful decryption program. Place the disk you are carrying in that computer.

objective.text: Put the disk in the computer

done.say: Uhh... {player}? Did you see that list on the computer? What the hell is your name doing on there? This can't be good.
This mission is complete. Time to head out.

mission.finish:
You have performed well, {player}. We shall begin the process of reverse engineering the insecticide, in order to produce enough for all of our operatives.
This matter of "Operation Omega" is troubling. This is the first we have heard of it. We shall look into this in the future.
